root.name: ベライゾン・コミュニケーションズ

companies.name: エーティーアンドティー

relations.text: 全米規模の無線通信事業者として競合している
relations.text_en: AT&T is a national wireless service provider that competes with Verizon

source.label: ベライゾン 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: With respect to our wireless connectivity products and services, we compete against other national wireless service providers, including AT&T Inc. and T-Mobile US, Inc., as well as various regional wireless service providers.

relations.text: 全米規模の無線通信事業者として競合している
relations.text_en: T-Mobile US is a national wireless service provider that competes with Verizon

source.label: ベライゾン 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: With respect to our wireless connectivity products and services, we compete against other national wireless service providers, including AT&T Inc. and T-Mobile US, Inc., as well as various regional wireless service providers.

relations.text: 卸売サービスを買って再販する事業者として、小売の契約獲得で競合する
relations.text_en: Comcast resells wholesale wireless service and competes for retail activations

source.label: ベライゾン 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We also compete for retail activations with resellers that buy bulk wholesale service from wireless service providers, including Verizon, and resell it to their customers. Resellers include cable companies, such as Comcast Corporation and Charter Communications, Inc., and others.

companies.name: チャーター・コミュニケーションズ

relations.text: 卸売サービスを買って再販する事業者として、小売の契約獲得で競合する
relations.text_en: Charter resells wholesale wireless service and competes for retail activations

source.label: ベライゾン 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We also compete for retail activations with resellers that buy bulk wholesale service from wireless service providers, including Verizon, and resell it to their customers. Resellers include cable companies, such as Comcast Corporation and Charter Communications, Inc., and others.

relations.text: 2025年3月にタワーのリース契約を更新した
relations.text_en: Verizon renewed its tower lease with American Tower in March 2025

source.label: ベライゾン 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In March 2025, we renewed our lease with American Tower Corporation (American Tower) originally entered into in March 2015.

companies.name: バーティカル・ブリッジ

relations.text: タワー取引を結び、賃借料が増えた
relations.text_en: Verizon has a tower transaction with Vertical Bridge that raised rent and lease expense

source.label: ベライゾン 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: an increase of $145 million in rent and lease expense primarily related to the tower transaction with Vertical Bridge REIT, LLC (Vertical Bridge) along with new leases and lease modifications related to the continued deployment of the C-Band spectrum.

companies.name: ティルマン・グローバル・ホールディングス

relations.text: 関連会社と光ファイバーの商用契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Verizon entered into a commercial fiber arrangement with an affiliate of Tillman Global Holdings

source.label: ベライゾン 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In addition, in October 2025, we entered into a commercial fiber arrangement with an affiliate of Tillman Global Holdings to further increase our fiber access reach.
